denominator_rule: count dependency relations with both latest observed version ordinal and a cutoff-known cohort support assertion; null when none are assessable

output.denominator: adoption relations with both latest version ordinal and a cutoff-known cohort support assertion
output.numerator: assessed adoption relations whose latest observed version major equals the provenance-bound cohort support assertion reviewed by cutoff

params.supported_major_semantics: latest version major equals the reviewed cohort supported major

status_note: published in rh-adoption-result/2 as an exact numerator/denominator ratio; missing or post-cutoff support assertions are excluded from the denominator and an empty denominator is not_applicable
